tactics: induction l generalizing acc <;> simp [List.filterMapM.loop] <;> simp_all

induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    congr 1
    funext x
    cases x <;> simp [ih (acc := _ :: _), ih (acc := [_ ])]
